"""Freeze bounded, source-derived F2FP candidates; only one instruction slot."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import struct

from decode_scan import decode
from harvest import sha

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def main():
    bases = json.loads((ROOT / "preparation/batch-native.json").read_text())
    unity = json.loads((ROOT / "preparation/batch-unity.json").read_text())
    records = []

    def add(name, base_name, low=None, high=None, role="candidate", hypothesis=""):
        base = bases[base_name]
        native = (ROOT / base["file"]).read_bytes()
        old_low, old_high = struct.unpack("<QQ", bytes.fromhex(base["encoding"]))
        low = old_low if low is None else low
        high = old_high if high is None else high
        # Control/scheduling bits 105..127 are never changed.
        assert high >> 41 == old_high >> 41
        code = struct.pack("<QQ", low, high)
        slot = base["text_file_offset"] + base["pc"]
        patched = native[:slot] + code + native[slot+16:]
        assert len(patched) == len(native)
        path = ROOT / "candidates" / (name+".cubin")
        path.write_bytes(patched)
        decoded = decode("candidate-"+name, low, high)
        item = {"name": name, "role": role, "hypothesis": hypothesis,
                "base": base_name, "file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "sha256": sha(patched), "encoding": code.hex(),
                "slot_file_offset": slot, "base_sha256": sha(native),
                "changed_byte_offsets": [i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(native,patched)) if a!=b],
                "outside_slot_identical": patched[:slot] == native[:slot] and
                    patched[slot+16:] == native[slot+16:],
                "decode": decoded}
        records.append(item)

    add("01-native-f16", "batch_f16", role="control_f16")
    add("02-native-ue8m0", "batch_scaled_bf16", role="control_ue8m0")
    lo, hi = struct.unpack("<QQ", bytes.fromhex(unity["encoding"]))
    add("03-patched-bf16-unity", "batch_f16", lo, hi, role="control_bf16",
        hypothesis="known native single-slot replacement must change f16 output bits to bf16")

    def format_fields(high, dtype, mode, sat=True):
        high &= ~((1 << 12) | (7 << 21) | (1 << 14) | (3 << 25) | (1 << 13))
        high |= (dtype & 1) << 12 | (dtype >> 1) << 21
        high |= (mode & 1) << 14 | (mode >> 1) << 25
        if sat:
            high |= 1 << 13
        return high

    _, scaled_high = struct.unpack("<QQ", bytes.fromhex(bases["batch_scaled_bf16"]["encoding"]))
    _, unscaled_high = struct.unpack("<QQ", bytes.fromhex(bases["batch_f16"]["encoding"]))
    for mode in range(8):
        add(f"direct-e4-scaled-form-mode{mode}", "batch_scaled_bf16",
            high=format_fields(scaled_high, 9, mode),
            hypothesis="known E4M3 destination field + E2M1 source + dynamic scale operand; mode sweep")
    for mode in (2,4,5):
        add(f"direct-e4-unscaled-form-mode{mode}", "batch_f16",
            high=format_fields(unscaled_high, 9, mode),
            hypothesis="known E4M3 destination field + E2M1 source in unscaled F2FP form")
    add("direct-e4-scaled-form-nosat", "batch_scaled_bf16",
        high=format_fields(scaled_high, 9, 2, False),
        hypothesis="same E4M3 candidate without saturation modifier")
    add("direct-e5-scaled-form", "batch_scaled_bf16",
        high=format_fields(scaled_high, 8, 2),
        hypothesis="alternate FP8 output field E5M2; classify separately from E4M3")
    # These bits precede scheduling bits and do not change operands or opcode.
    # nvdisasm omits them from the text: only execution can distinguish no-op
    # aliases from an undisplayed scale interpretation or reserved encoding.
    opaque_bits = [20] + list(range(28,41))
    for bit in opaque_bits:
        add(f"scale-opaque-high{bit}", "batch_scaled_bf16",
            high=scaled_high ^ (1 << bit),
            hypothesis="test undisplayed bit for scale interpretation or reserved behavior")
    add("scale-opaque-combined", "batch_scaled_bf16",
        high=scaled_high ^ sum(1 << b for b in opaque_bits),
        hypothesis="bounded combined probe of the individually undisplayed bits")
    add("scaled-format0", "batch_scaled_bf16", high=scaled_high ^ (1 << 12),
        hypothesis="destination format 0 in the dynamic-scale form")
    add("99-native-health", "batch_f16", role="control_f16")
    assert len(records) == 33
    (ROOT / "preparation/candidates.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "scope": "33 processes: 4 controls, 29 candidates; no arbitrary opcode search",
        "format_fields_high64": {"dtype": [12,21,22,23], "source": [9,10,18,19],
                                  "mode": [14,25,26], "satfinite": 13, "relu": 11},
        "dtype_codes_observed": {"0": "F16", "1": "BF16", "3": "E2M1",
                                  "6": "E2M3", "7": "E3M2", "8": "E5M2", "9": "E4M3"},
        "source_codes_observed": {"0": "F32", "1": "F16", "2": "E5M2",
                                   "3": "E4M3", "5": "E2M1", "6": "E2M3",
                                   "7": "E3M2", "9": "BF16"},
        "candidates": records,
    }, indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps({"count":len(records), "controls":4, "candidates":29,
                      "all_patches_single_slot":all(r["outside_slot_identical"] for r in records)}))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Classify raw results; successful launch alone does not imply the target op."""
from pathlib import Path
import struct

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def words(blob):
    return [v[0] for v in struct.iter_unpack("<I", blob)]


def classify(path):
    blob = Path(path).read_bytes()
    output = words(blob[16:-16])
    n = len(output)
    assert n == 35073
    refs = {name: words((ROOT / "data" / (name+".bin")).read_bytes())
            for name in ("f16", "bf16_unity", "bf16_ue8m0", "direct_e4",
                         "scaled_e4", "direct_e5", "scaled_e5")}
    result = {"vectors": n, "guards_ok": blob[:16] == blob[-16:] == b"\xa5"*16,
              "first_output": hex(output[0]), "full32_matches": {}, "fp8_matches": {}}
    for name in ("f16", "bf16_unity", "bf16_ue8m0"):
        result["full32_matches"][name] = sum(a == b for a,b in zip(output,refs[name]))
    result["ue_normal_subset_matches"] = sum(a == b for a,b in
        zip(output[32769:],refs["bf16_ue8m0"][32769:]))
    for name in ("direct_e4", "scaled_e4", "direct_e5", "scaled_e5"):
        count = 32769 if name.startswith("scaled") else n
        result["fp8_matches"][name] = {"count":count}
        for label, shift in (("low16",0),("high16",16)):
            matched = sum(((a >> shift) & 65535) == b for a,b in
                          zip(output[:count],refs[name][:count]))
            result["fp8_matches"][name][label] = matched
    result["target_matches"] = [name + ":" + lane for name,entry in
        result["fp8_matches"].items() for lane in ("low16","high16")
        if entry[lane] == entry["count"]]
    return result

"""Bounded CPU-only field scan around four native F2FP encodings."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import subprocess

from harvest import DISASM

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def decode(name, low, high):
    path = ROOT / "decode" / (name+".bin")
    path.write_bytes(struct.pack("<QQ", low, high))
    argv = [str(DISASM), "--binary", "SM110a", "--no-dataflow",
            "--print-instruction-encoding", str(path)]
    result = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    hit = re.search(r"/\*0000\*/\s+([^;]+);", result.stdout)
    return {"name": name, "low64": hex(low), "high64": hex(high),
            "argv": argv, "returncode": result.returncode,
            "SASS": hit.group(1).strip() if hit else None,
            "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr}


def main():
    harvest = json.loads((ROOT / "preparation/harvest.json").read_text())
    output = []
    for base in ("unpack_f16_e2m1", "scaled_bf16_e2m1",
                 "pack_e4m3_f16", "pack_e4m3_f32"):
        low, high = struct.unpack("<QQ", bytes.fromhex(harvest[base]["encoding"]))
        for bit in range(8, 29):
            item = decode(base+"-flip-high-"+str(bit), low, high ^ (1 << bit))
            item.update({"base": base, "flipped_high_bit": bit})
            output.append(item)
            print(base, bit, item["SASS"] or "DECODE_REJECTED")
    (ROOT / "preparation/bit-scan.json").write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2)+"\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""CPU-only build, isolation snapshot and immutable experiment bounds."""
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from environment import snapshot
from harvest import sha

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
argv=["/usr/bin/g++-14","-std=c++23","-O2","-Wall","-Wextra","-Werror",
      "-I/usr/local/cuda-13.3/include",str(ROOT/"probe.cpp"),"-lcuda","-o",str(ROOT/"probe")]
result=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60,
                      env=dict(os.environ,TMPDIR=str(ROOT/"tmp")))
(ROOT/"preparation/host-build.command.json").write_text(json.dumps({
    "argv":argv,"returncode":result.returncode},indent=2)+"\n")
(ROOT/"preparation/host-build.stdout.txt").write_text(result.stdout)
(ROOT/"preparation/host-build.stderr.txt").write_text(result.stderr)
assert result.returncode==0 and not result.stderr,result.stderr
(ROOT/"preparation/environment-before.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot(),indent=2)+"\n")
files=[str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in ROOT.glob("*.py")]
files += ["probe.cpp","probe","preparation/candidates.json","preparation/oracle.json",
          "preparation/environment-before.json"]
files += [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in sorted((ROOT/"candidates").glob("*.cubin"))]
files += [str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in sorted((ROOT/"data").glob("*.bin"))]
plan={"scope":"bounded F2FP format and scale encoding research; not performance",
      "max_processes":33,"controls":4,"candidate_processes":29,"max_kernel_launches":66,
      "first_launch":"one thread, one vector; stop this candidate on CUDA fault",
      "second_launch_if_smoke_succeeds":"35073 vectors, 275 blocks x 128 threads",
      "device_bytes_per_process":420908,"worker_timeout_seconds":20,"stage_timeout_seconds":120,
      "patch_boundary":"one 16-byte F2FP slot; no changes to pointer arithmetic, control flow or scheduling bits",
      "after_instruction_fault":"end candidate process; fresh context for next; native health last",
      "sha256":{name:sha((ROOT/name).read_bytes()) for name in files}}
(ROOT/"plan.json").write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"build":"ZERO_WARNINGS","frozen_inputs":len(files),
                  "plan_sha256":sha((ROOT/"plan.json").read_bytes()),"max_processes":33}))

"""Run the frozen F2FP candidate matrix under one repository GPU lease."""
from datetime import datetime
import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPO = ROOT.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "tools/evalscope"))
import gpu_exclusive
import nvml_process_query
from classify import classify
from environment import snapshot


def save(result):
    (ROOT / "runtime/result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")


def execute(candidate, env):
    prefix = ROOT / "runtime" / candidate["name"]
    argv = [str(ROOT / "probe"), str(ROOT / candidate["file"]),
            str(ROOT / "data/inputs.bin"), str(prefix)]
    started = time.monotonic()
    child = subprocess.Popen(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                             text=True, env=env)
    timeout = False
    try:
        stdout,stderr = child.communicate(timeout=20)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        timeout = True
        child.kill()
        stdout,stderr = child.communicate(timeout=5)
    prefix.with_suffix(".stdout.jsonl").write_text(stdout)
    prefix.with_suffix(".stderr.txt").write_text(stderr)
    events = [json.loads(line) for line in stdout.splitlines()]
    value = {"name":candidate["name"],"role":candidate["role"],"argv":argv,
             "pid":child.pid,"returncode":child.returncode,"timed_out":timeout,
             "elapsed_seconds":time.monotonic()-started,
             "errors":[e for e in events if e["event"]=="cuda_error"],
             "launches_accepted":sum(e["event"]=="cuda_success" and
                                      e["api"]=="cuLaunchKernel" for e in events)}
    actual = prefix.with_suffix(".actual.bin")
    if child.returncode==0:
        assert not stderr and any(e["event"]=="completed" for e in events)
        value["numeric"] = classify(actual)
        assert value["numeric"]["guards_ok"]
        value["outcome"] = "EXECUTED"
    elif value["errors"]:
        error = value["errors"][-1]
        value["outcome"] = ("GPU_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION" if error["code"]==715 and
                             error["api"]=="cuCtxSynchronize" else
                             "MODULE_REJECTED" if error["api"]=="cuModuleLoadDataEx" else
                             "OTHER_CUDA_ERROR")
    else:
        value["outcome"] = "PROCESS_FAILURE"
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in value.items() if k not in ("argv","numeric")}),flush=True)
    return value


def main():
    (ROOT / "runtime").mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    result = {"status":"INITIALIZING","phases":[],
              "started_asia_shanghai":datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat(),
              "plan_sha256":hashlib.sha256((ROOT / "plan.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    started = time.monotonic()
    def deadline(_signal,_frame):
        raise TimeoutError("ENV_ABORT: stage 120-second deadline")
    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,deadline)
    signal.alarm(120)
    try:
        plan=json.loads((ROOT / "plan.json").read_text())
        for name,expected in plan["sha256"].items():
            assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
        parent=Path(f"/proc/{os.getppid()}/cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
        assert any(arg.endswith(b"tools/evalscope/gpu_exclusive.py") for arg in parent)
        with gpu_exclusive.common_lock().open("r+") as lock:
            try:
                fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
            except BlockingIOError:
                pass
            else:
                raise RuntimeError("ENV_ABORT: GPU lease not held")
        overrides={"CUDA_CACHE_DISABLE":"1","CUDA_FORCE_PTX_JIT":"0",
                   "CUDA_DISABLE_PTX_JIT":"1","CUDA_MODULE_LOADING":"EAGER",
                   "CUDA_CACHE_PATH":str(ROOT/"cache"),"TMPDIR":str(ROOT/"tmp")}
        env=dict(os.environ,**overrides)
        result["child_environment_overrides"]=overrides
        candidates=json.loads((ROOT/"preparation/candidates.json").read_text())["candidates"]
        for candidate in candidates:
            phase=execute(candidate,env)
            result["phases"].append(phase)
            save(result)
            if phase["timed_out"]:
                raise RuntimeError("ENV_ABORT: owned candidate timed out")
            if phase["outcome"] in ("OTHER_CUDA_ERROR","PROCESS_FAILURE"):
                raise RuntimeError("unexpected candidate failure: "+phase["name"])
            role=candidate["role"]
            if role.startswith("control"):
                assert phase["outcome"]=="EXECUTED", "native/patch control failed"
                numeric=phase["numeric"]
                key={"control_f16":"f16","control_bf16":"bf16_unity",
                     "control_ue8m0":"bf16_ue8m0"}[role]
                if role=="control_ue8m0":
                    assert numeric["ue_normal_subset_matches"]==2304
                else:
                    assert numeric["full32_matches"][key]==35073
        result["status"]="COMPLETED"
    except BaseException as error:
        result["status"]=("ENV_ABORT" if isinstance(error,KeyboardInterrupt) or
                          "ENV_ABORT" in str(error) else "FAILED")
        result["reason"]=repr(error)
    result["cleanup_queries"]=[]
    try:
        for _ in range(10):
            query=nvml_process_query.query(timeout=5)
            result["cleanup_queries"].append(query)
            if query["status"]!="OK":
                raise RuntimeError("ENV_ABORT: cleanup NVML failed")
            if not query["pids"]:
                result["gpu_compute_contexts_empty"]=True
                break
            time.sleep(.25)
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("ENV_ABORT: remaining GPU contexts")
    except Exception as error:
        result["status"]="ENV_ABORT"
        result["cleanup_reason"]=repr(error)
    (ROOT/"runtime/environment-after.json").write_text(json.dumps(snapshot(),indent=2)+"\n")
    result["elapsed_seconds"]=time.monotonic()-started
    signal.alarm(0)
    save(result)
    print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ("phases","cleanup_queries")}),flush=True)
    return 0 if result["status"]=="COMPLETED" else 75


if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
